openQuestions: Confirm the TASK-001 direction: the approved plan says ".agents/hooks is the real path, .claude/hooks is the symlink" but reality is the opposite (readlink .agents/hooks = ../.claude/hooks). By default docs follow reality; reversing the symlink would be a separate task with installer/symlink risk.

TASK-003: for pull_request, actions/checkout checks out the merge commit by default so HEAD^ HEAD may already cover the whole PR (not verified against official docs in this turn); the clearer gap is the push event with multiple commits (only the last commit is checked). Extend to push (using github.event.before)? By default only the PR part is done as in the approved plan.
Is the way of marking the plugin plan cancelled (tag + description prefix + blockers) what the user intends?
content.technicalSolution:
Execute sequentially 001 -> 005, each task self-verifies before moving to the next.

1. Docs (TASK-001, main session edits docs): in .claude/hooks/README.md replace the line 294 sentence with a correct description: scripts physically live in .claude/hooks/scripts/, .agents/hooks is a symlink to .claude/hooks, settings call via $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.agents/hooks/scripts/<name>. Unify: when stating file location use .claude/hooks/scripts (physical), when stating commands/settings use .agents/hooks/scripts (the path settings use); add one sentence explaining the symlink relationship at the top of the README. README.md section Development gets one sentence: docs/**/index.json is .gitignored, only checked locally with check-agent-config.py.

2. Checker (TASK-002, coder): in scripts/check-agent-config.py, after the .claude/.codex rules|skills loop (lines 12-16) add a loop for folder in (hooks, agents, commands): path = root/.agents/folder must is_symlink() and resolve() == (root/.claude/folder).resolve(), error '.agents/<folder>: expected link to .claude/<folder>'. Add a hook script check: read .claude/settings.json and .codex/hooks.json with json (stdlib), walk every command string, regex find '.agents/hooks/scripts/[\w.-]+', each name must be a file in root/.agents/hooks/scripts; error '<settings file>: missing hook script <path>'. A missing settings file is skipped (fixture/project without that runtime); invalid JSON reports an error. Update the success message if needed and sync the SUCCESS regex in the test. Tests: update validTree to add the .agents/commands link and .claude/commands/<file>, add a minimal .claude/settings.json pointing to a real script; add 2 short tests (commands symlink wrong target; script in settings does not exist).

3. CI (TASK-003, coder): .github/workflows/agent-config.yml step 'Check whitespace errors': pull_request -> git diff --check ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }} HEAD (checkout fetch-depth: 0 or fetch the base sha); push -> keep git diff --check HEAD^ HEAD. May split into two steps with if: github.event_name. Do not add a docs index check step.

4. Compact the hook README (TASK-004, main session docs): before writing, list anchors/links pointing into .claude/hooks/README.md from the whole repo (grep 'hooks/README.md'), the list of 21 scripts in settings and the operational information of each section. Rewrite each hook as a block: heading '## <name>' (keep the old heading if an anchor references it), Script, Event/matcher (cross-check settings.json and .codex/hooks.json), Behavior, Limits/dependencies. Keep the install-to-another-project part, rtk, dedupe guard. Keep the user's uncommitted hunk.

5. Plugin cleanup (TASK-005, main session): run find <dir> -type f | wc -l for the 3 directories, delete only if = 0 using find <dir> -depth -type d -empty -delete (not rm -rf). Edit docs/plans/lumina-plugin-20261023.json and the entry in docs/plans/index.json per the cancel marking in assumptions.

Data/API/migration: no database, API or migration. Rollback: all files are tracked by git except docs/plans/* (gitignored, kept local) and the 3 untracked empty directories (recreate with mkdir if needed).

Common verification after each task: npm test; python3 scripts/check-agent-config.py; python3 scripts/check_docs.py; git diff --check; check final newline of changed files.
